passages.title: Recount Text: A Visit to the Art Studio
passages.text: Last Monday, our English club visited a small art studio for a school project. We left school after the first lesson and arrived at 9:15. At the entrance, the instructor welcomed us and divided us into pairs. First, we looked at several posters and discussed their colours and shapes. Then, the instructor showed us how moving a title could change the way a poster looked. While my partner sketched a design, I wrote down three ideas for our own poster. After a short break, each pair created a draft and displayed it on the wall. Before we left, the instructor gave us one suggestion about making our message easier to read. We returned to school before lunch. I enjoyed the visit because I could test an idea instead of only reading about design. I also learned that small changes can make a poster clearer.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the passage?
choices: To retell the English club’s visit to an art studio.
To give instructions for opening an art studio.
To describe the history of a famous painting.
To report general facts about school clubs.
questions.explanation: Bacaan mengenalkan kunjungan English club, lalu menceritakan kegiatan yang dilakukan dari kedatangan hingga kembali ke sekolah. Fokusnya adalah pengalaman yang terjadi pada waktu tertentu, bukan petunjuk atau fakta umum.

choices: Menceritakan kembali kunjungan English club ke sebuah studio seni.
Memberikan petunjuk untuk membuka studio seni.
Menggambarkan sejarah sebuah lukisan terkenal.
Menyajikan fakta umum tentang klub sekolah.

questions.evidence: Last Monday, our English club visited a small art studio for a school project.

questions.prompt: When did the English club arrive at the art studio?
choices: After lunch.
Before the first lesson.
Just before dinner.
questions.explanation: Kalimat kedua menyatakan bahwa kelompok tiba pukul 9:15. Waktu keberangkatan dan waktu kepulangan disebut secara terpisah.

translationId.prompt: Kapan English club tiba di studio seni?
choices: Setelah makan siang.
Pukul 9:15.
Sebelum pelajaran pertama.
Tepat sebelum makan malam.

questions.evidence: We left school after the first lesson and arrived at 9:15.

questions.prompt: What did the students do first after they were divided into pairs?
choices: They created a draft and displayed it.
They returned to school before lunch.
They looked at posters and discussed their colours and shapes.
They interviewed the instructor about the studio.
questions.explanation: Kata “First” menandai kegiatan awal setelah siswa dibagi menjadi pasangan, yaitu melihat beberapa poster dan mendiskusikan warna serta bentuknya.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang pertama kali dilakukan siswa setelah mereka dibagi menjadi pasangan?
choices: Mereka membuat draf dan memajangnya.
Mereka kembali ke sekolah sebelum makan siang.
Mereka melihat poster dan mendiskusikan warna serta bentuknya.
Mereka mewawancarai instruktur tentang studio tersebut.

questions.evidence: First, we looked at several posters and discussed their colours and shapes.

questions.prompt: What does “while” show in the sentence about the partner sketching?
choices: The sketch happened the day before the visit.
The writer completed the poster before the partner started.
The partner stopped sketching because the writer took notes.
The two activities happened at the same time.
questions.explanation: “While” menunjukkan bahwa teman membuat sketsa ketika penulis menuliskan ide. Kedua kegiatan berlangsung bersamaan, bukan berurutan.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang ditunjukkan oleh kata “while” dalam kalimat tentang teman yang membuat sketsa?
choices: Sketsa dibuat sehari sebelum kunjungan.
Penulis menyelesaikan poster sebelum temannya mulai.
Teman berhenti membuat sketsa karena penulis mencatat.
Kedua kegiatan berlangsung pada waktu yang sama.

questions.evidence: While my partner sketched a design, I wrote down three ideas for our own poster.

questions.prompt: Which word is an irregular simple past verb in the passage?
choices: left
visited
divided
created
questions.explanation: “Left” adalah bentuk lampau irregular dari “leave”. Kata “visited”, “divided”, dan “created” merupakan bentuk regular yang memakai akhiran -ed.

translationId.prompt: Kata mana yang merupakan kata kerja simple past irregular dalam bacaan?
choices: left
visited
divided
created

questions.evidence: We left school after the first lesson and arrived at 9:15.

questions.prompt: Which sentence expresses the writer’s reflection rather than an event?
choices: The instructor welcomed us and divided us into pairs.
I also learned that small changes can make a poster clearer.
Each pair created a draft and displayed it on the wall.
We returned to school before lunch.
questions.explanation: Kalimat tersebut menyampaikan pemahaman yang diperoleh penulis setelah kunjungan. Pilihan lain menyebut tindakan yang terjadi selama kegiatan.

translationId.prompt: Kalimat mana yang menyatakan refleksi penulis, bukan kejadian?
choices: Instruktur menyambut kami dan membagi kami menjadi pasangan.
Saya juga belajar bahwa perubahan kecil dapat membuat poster lebih jelas.
Setiap pasangan membuat draf dan memajangnya di dinding.
Kami kembali ke sekolah sebelum makan siang.

questions.evidence: I also learned that small changes can make a poster clearer.

questions.prompt: Why did the writer enjoy the visit?
choices: The instructor cancelled the school project.
The club did not have to return to school.
The writer could test an idea instead of only reading about design.
The writer received a new poster from the instructor.
questions.explanation: Penulis menyatakan alasan secara langsung: ia dapat mencoba sebuah ide, bukan hanya membaca tentang desain. Alasan ini menjelaskan tanggapan pribadi terhadap kunjungan.

choices: Instruktur membatalkan proyek sekolah.
Klub tidak perlu kembali ke sekolah.
Penulis dapat mencoba sebuah ide, bukan hanya membaca tentang desain.
Penulis menerima poster baru dari instruktur.

questions.evidence: I enjoyed the visit because I could test an idea instead of only reading about design.
